sources.entry: YouTube Downloader for macOS - Simple menu bar app to download YouTube movies on your Mac. I wrote this as a test project to learn more about app development on macOS.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS menu bar app for downloading YouTube videos, built by its author as a test project to learn macOS app development.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a menu bar app that downloads YouTube movies to a Mac. It names Alamofire and yt-dlp as acknowledged dependencies, which suggests yt-dlp handles the actual downloading and Alamofire handles networking, but the README does not explain how they are used. Installation is via a releases page or a Homebrew cask named youtube-downloader. The README is very short and does not document features, settings, or supported formats. The author states the project was written as a test project to learn macOS app development.
use_cases: download YouTube videos on a Mac
save YouTube movies for offline viewing
how_to_run: Or download the latest version from the releases page
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar
Uses yt-dlp as an acknowledged dependency
Written as a learning project for macOS app development
caveats: README is very short and does not document features, settings, or supported formats
Described by its author as a test project for learning macOS development
